author: nathll005
quote: Grand Theft Auto VI is the most boring videogame I have ever played in my life. It's a shame, because I was a massive fan of RDR2. The gunplay feels to be a complete downgrade from 5 in that it no longer feels anywhere near as smooth or satisfying (with the exception that you now have the ability to incapacitate rather than shoot to kill) - and 5's gunplay was already a complete downgrade from GTA 4! Having optional missions and side-quests in which you spend what feels like 40 minutes doing actual housework and buying groceries is quite frankly insane, I actually found myself audibly sighing to myself out of genuine boredom. The main story forces you to spend upwards of 200 hours grinding these insufferable side-quests in order to earn 2 million and unlock the only happy ending - and no, that's not an exaggeration. Rockstar themselves even provided that specific time frame. The main plot is utterly and entirely forgettable, I couldn't tell you what the story was if I even tried. Lucia and Jason are completely forgettable and I felt absolutely nothing for them. The main missions are, for the most part, extremely boring and feel like a chore to complete - which is never something I thought I would say for a GTA game. When the main missions do get good, they simply just feel completely scripted! I'm really not a fan. I was looking forward to this game so much, but it's just so boring! I loved GTA San Andreas for the PS2, I loved GTA 4 for the Xbox 360, and I loved GTA 5 - but this one just **** man.
